actions.action: Pinch off the flower spikes just above a pair of leaves
Pinch the growing tips of each shoot weekly
Check the top inch of soil with a finger and water when dry
Place the plant in the brightest (south or west facing) window
Check that nighttime temperatures stay above about 10°C and the last frost has passed before moving outdoors
Harden off outdoors over 7 to 10 days, adding sun exposure each day
Plant outdoors in well-drained soil in a sunny spot
